name: DeepSeek Harness adds Creator Mode for building plugins
title: DeepSeek Harness adds Creator Mode for building plugins
summary: DeepSeek Harness added Creator Mode, which turns a written idea into a plugin the user can run. The launch examples include a design workspace, a sandbox game, and a 3D language-model visualizer.
